Subject: Alert Golden Gate Bridge 11/1/26 Golden Gate Marathon
TextBody:
On Sunday, November 01, 2026 from 5 AM - 11 AM the *e**ast and west sidewalks will be closed for the Golden Gate Half Marathon. [ https://www.goldengatehalf.com/ ]* 

*Event Hours:* 7:10 AM – 10:00 AM
*Number of Participants Expected*: 4000-5000 

Cyclists and Pedestrians, during this event please note:
*East Sidewalk:* Closed to pedestrians and bicyclists.
*West Sidewalk:* Closed to bicyclists.

*Bike shuttles* will be available for transporting pedestrians and bicycles between the East Lot and Alexander Avenue bus pad.

*Bridge roadway *will REMAIN OPEN to traffic at all times.

________________________________________________________________________


For trip-planning assistance, call 511/415-455-2000/TDD 711. Customer service representatives are available weekdays from 7:00 am to 6:00 pm.
